name: reliance-annual-report-2024-25
description: Reliance Industries Limited Integrated Annual Report 2024-25 (financial year ended 31 March 2025). The week block, the calendar-month subdivision and the quarter template are illustrative; only fields the document states are asserted.

source.citation: "Financial Year April 1 to March 31" (Corporate Governance Report, General Shareholder Information, p. 58) "Financial Calendar (Tentative) Results for the quarter ending June 30, 2025 - Third week of July, 2025; September 30, 2025 - Third week of October, 2025; December 31, 2025 - Third week of January, 2026; and March 31, 2026 - Fourth week of April, 2026." (p. 58) "There has been no revision in credit ratings during the FY 2024-25." and "Annual listing fees for the FY 2025-26 has been paid by the Company to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited." (p. 58) "The Board of Directors present the Company’s Forty-eighth Annual Report (Post-IPO) and the Company’s audited financial statements for the financial year ended March 31, 2025." (Board's Report, p. 76) Statement of Changes in Equity (p. 114): "Balance as at 1st April, 2023", "Change during the year 2023-24", "Balance as at 31st March, 2024", "Change during the year 2024-25" and "B. Other Equity Balance as at 1st April, 2024". Establishes the 1 April start, start-year naming in the form FY 2024-25, the bounds of 2023-24 and 2024-25, the end of FY 2025-26, and the last day of each quarter of FY 2025-26 (the four quarter ends listed in order).
